name: Net MRR
definition: Monthly Recurring Revenue deducting refunded or failed transactions
sql_formula: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)

name: VIP Customer
definition: A registered user with more than $1,000 in total completed order spend
sql_formula: orders.status = 'completed' GROUP BY users.id HAVING SUM(orders.total_amount) >= 1000

name: Active Customer
definition: Users with is_active = TRUE and at least one completed order in the last 90 days
sql_formula: users.is_active = TRUE AND orders.status = 'completed' AND orders.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'

name: Low Stock Threshold
definition: Available products with stock_quantity strictly below 20 units

name: VIP Customer
definition: A customer who has spent over $1,000 in completed orders.
